description: Open any public page of nicheof.one by its path ("/", "/academy/", "/shop/first-frequency/"): its text, the site navigation, the pages under it and what a visitor can do there. Long pages come in parts. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

page.description: Part of a long page, and page of its child list.

path.description: An absolute site path, like /academy/. Defaults to the home page.
